recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中，脂肪與骨小樑旁有一個界線不清的間質性結節，由大量淡染上皮樣組織球與小淋巴球組成，其間散在少數有核仁的較大細胞，外觀類似肉芽腫，但需以免疫染色找出散在的大型 B 細胞。
features: Ill-defined interstitial nodule adjacent to a bony trabecula within fatty marrow
Nodule rich in epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval nuclei
Admixed small lymphocytes with dark irregular nuclei
Scattered larger cells with vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli, few in number
No necrosis or multinucleated giant cells; surrounding marrow contains hematopoietic cells
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows an ill-defined interstitial lymphohistiocytic nodule next to a bony trabecula. The nodule is composed of abundant epithelioid histiocytes and small lymphocytes, with scattered larger cells showing vesicular nuclei and visible nucleoli. There is no necrosis and no multinucleated giant cells; the surrounding marrow contains fat and hematopoietic elements. The granuloma-like appearance could be mistaken for a reactive process; with immunohistochemistry demonstrating scattered large B cells in a T-cell-rich background, findings are consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive granulomas are tight epithelioid aggregates often with giant cells and lack atypical CD20+/OCT2+ large cells.
cHL marrow involvement is often fibrotic with CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells that are OCT2- and CD20- or weak.
Lennert lymphoma has epithelioid histiocyte clusters but the atypical cells are small-to-medium T cells with aberrant phenotype.
